purpose: Entry point for all Grade 1-6 concept intelligence profiles.

china_textbook.sequence_resolution_rule: Resolve authoritative grade/semester/unit sequence first; resolve unit-concept links and corrections second; load below-unit detail/status third; resolve artifact identity fourth; resolve locality/term rollout separately only when the question concerns actual use.

resolver_rules: Resolve each concept in exactly one profile.
Apply curriculum_seed_corrections after the legacy seed map for the listed CN concept records.
Use assembly_rules.json for visible readiness/evidence labels.
For China curriculum claims, prefer cn_printed_locators for printed domain range plus exact hierarchy/stage/subsection; do not fabricate a per-bullet page number.
For PEP revised series, use the authoritative sequence for grade/semester/unit placement, then apply unit-concept corrections.
Load below-unit detail as evidence extensions; secondary lesson indexes cannot override authoritative unit sequence.
Apply pep_subsection_status_corrections before describing a volume as current/in use.
Artifact identity is independent of sequence: an ISBN/date is shown only when the accepted artifact matches the revised edition; rejected legacy ISBNs must never be reused.
A verified first-edition date with unresolved ISBN must remain labelled ISBN pending.
Use pep_rollout_evidence only for locality/term rollout questions. Series design, artifact identity and rollout are separate dimensions.
Keep PEP textbook sequence separate from China national curriculum stages and school/locality adoption.
Every canonical diagnostic misconception must resolve through diagnostic_full_classification to one explicit evidence class.
Curriculum-inferred diagnostic records must be presented only as possible reasoning patterns/probes, never as research-established misconceptions.
Direct evidence for a reasoning pattern does not validate a MathBridge diagnostic question or establish prevalence.
Resolve an optional classroom task through database/classroom_tasks/runtime_manifest.json by concept_id; a task is an instructional option, not evidence of national practice.
Use stored Chinese classroom-task fields/overlays rather than live translation when present.
Use England for statutory England curriculum claims.
Treat Common Core as a US baseline when no state is selected.
When California or Texas is selected, use state overlays when available and do not silently substitute Common Core for missing state mappings.
Do not use legacy PEP sequence as current.
Do not infer same-numbered grade equivalence across systems.
